items.title: Lester Santiago Interview, 1959-01-09
items.q: I replaced Dwight Newman with Eddie Jackson's orchestra on the music box. I also played, uh, uh, majority of the, uh, Dwight Newman's dance places

ctx.x: Did you ever know Dwight Newman?

Yeah, I knew Dwight. Uh, Dwight Newman, I replaced Dwight Newman with Eddie Jackson's orchestra on the music box. I also played, uh, uh, majority of the, uh, Dwight Newman's dance places, you know, the Jitney dances.
